title: zazzle-agent component diagram
description: The zazzle-agent crate: a library that finds the rule and skill files for a path, scopes rules by their `paths:` globs, follows `@file` imports and filters by purpose markers, a thin binary, and the zazzle invoker that execs it for `zazzle agent`.

components.name: zazzle-agent-rules-list
components.responsibility: The package and its binary zazzle-agent.

components.name: Rule finder
components.responsibility: Walks the home folder and every folder down to the path for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/rules (at any depth) and SKILL.md files, drops repeats, adds imported files after their rule, and prints names or text.

components.name: Purpose markers
components.responsibility: Reads #zazzle-purpose markers and decides which whole files or line ranges match the wanted purposes.

components.name: Front matter
components.responsibility: Reads YAML front-matter fields: skill descriptions on one line and rule `paths:` lists.

components.name: Path globs
components.responsibility: Matches `paths:` globs (`*`, `?`, `**`, `{a,b}`) against the path, letting a folder match when files under it could.

components.name: Imports
components.responsibility: Finds and resolves `@file` imports outside code, relative to the rule, under home or absolute.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: Execs the zazzle-agent beside itself for `zazzle agent ARGS`.

relationships.description: Asks which part of each file applies when --purpose is given.
Reads skill descriptions and rule `paths:` lists.
Asks whether a scoped rule's globs match the path.
Asks which files a rule imports, and whether a file only imports listed files.
Execs the zazzle-agent binary from its own directory.
